events.descriptionHtml:
Energy grid planning is one of the most critical components in shaping the future of global energy systems. As modern societies become increasingly dependent on electricity for everything from communication and transportation to healthcare and industry, ensuring a stable, efficient, and sustainable power supply has become a top priority.

Ultimately, energy grid planning is not just a technical discipline; it’s a vital part of national development strategy. It links energy policy with environmental goals, industrial growth, and social welfare.
